title: Spend a starry night at McDonald Observatory
description: Drive into West Texas for a Star Party at McDonald Observatory, where staff help visitors find constellations and look through telescopes when skies allow. The dark setting is part of the experience: let your eyes adjust, follow the guide’s pointing hand, and look again at how many stars were there all along.
teaser: Look through telescopes under West Texas skies.
goodToKnow: Altitude, cold, weather and some walking. Confirm program and telescope access.
whyItMightDelightYou: Someone helping you read the sky can turn distant points of light into places and stories.
